positive_contract: Legal actions, verified success, and protected-object contact checks at every integration step under the explicit per-row contract
negative_contract: Independently rechecked sufficient exclusion certificate; failed rollouts never supply negatives
ancestry_rule: All policy repeats, checkpoints, renderings and interventions sharing a source stay in one split; task-template overlap is separately reported
training_gate: Exactly 1000 accepted rows, verified evidence, source coverage, balanced matched constructions, student-visible rationale premises and frozen grouped shortcut evaluation must all pass
contact_actor_scope: Robot plus every manipulated native task target versus the protected object; native support contacts allowed
contact_sampling: Native initial state and every integration step; separate synchronized initial/action endpoints
prior_contract: protocol_v1.json and all prior frozen run sources remain immutable; prior rejects require fresh v2 replay
